answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake bond before transacting, held through a vesting window and slashed on proven fraud. One identity can echo only a capped number of offers per epoch, so a Sybil operator must fund a separate bond for every fake, multiplying capital cost and lockup time, while honest agents reclaim theirs intact. Reputation builds per bonded identity, and reaching the summit of trusted tiers takes a long clean history, so a fresh army of fakes stays expensive and visibly untrusted; a violet audit tag marks any identity ever slashed.
